capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Press kit: 91 kWh total (the page's "total" is read as gross). The Car Guide (Canada 2026) lists this trim with this pack.

chemistry.notes: EV Database: NMC cathode for the 87 kWh pack (Nissan pages say only "lithium-ion").

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US owner's manual (2023 and 2025 carry the same text) describes a manual "Battery Heater" setting (Home > Settings > EV), switched ON 30-60 min before a quick charger, plus an automatic warmer when cold during quick charging; it describes no navigation trigger, and EV Database (MY23-24 Ariya 87 kWh, https://ev-database.org/car/1305/Nissan-Ariya-e-4ORCE-87kWh-Performance) says preconditioning is possible but not automatic via navigation. A manual that is silent on navigation does not prove there is none. EV Database lists the European MY26 Ariya as automatic via navigation: conflict, not applied to North American cars. Quote the manual text again before this goes live. Applied to 2026 from the 2023/2025 manuals.

published_10_80_min.notes: Press kit: 40 min at 130 kW (the FWD table labels it 20-80 %, the e-4ORCE table 10-80 %; Nissan Canada says "10 % to 80 % in as little as 40 minutes").
